context_requirements: Functional Hedgehog pathway with SMO expression and intact downstream GLI activation
Presence of GLI1/GLI2 transcriptional output or PTCH1 feedback
Absence of strong constitutive downstream pathway activation that bypasses SMO
Cellular context permissive for GLI-dependent transcriptional changes
falsifiers: No consistent directional change in GLI2, PTGS2, CCND1, MYC, BIRC5, CXCR4, MMP2, TGFB3, SPP1, or IL1B at 6 h or 24 h in any responsive line
No dose- or time-dependent transcriptional signature across the nine lines
Predicted up/down genes move in the opposite direction or remain unchanged in all lines
Response indistinguishable from vehicle or from generic stress/proliferation programs
